Hi Sanjay,

Thanks again for the time earlier — excited to get Novus onboarded. Two quick items we should cover in a short call: 1) walk through the MSA redline highlights (we captured the outstanding clauses in the attached summary) and 2) preflight checklist for the vendor onboarding (SSO, SOC2 evidence, data handling).

Proposed 45-minute windows (please pick any that work for your group; listed with PT / ET / UTC):
- Tue Sep 8 — 10:00 PT / 13:00 ET / 17:00 UTC
- Tue Sep 8 — 14:00 PT / 17:00 ET / 21:00 UTC
- Wed Sep 9 — 09:00 PT / 12:00 ET / 16:00 UTC

If those windows don't work, tell us a couple alternatives and we will mirror across our legal calendar.

Best,

Thanks, Ava — appreciate the summary. Karen Li (our procurement lead) is on copy now.

We'd like to prioritize the MSA redline walk and confirm SCIM/SSO approach and SOC 2 artifacts during the same call. Our procurement team prefers the Tue Sep 8 slot at 13:00 ET (10:00 PT). Can Marissa/legal make that?

Sounds good — we can do Tue Sep 8 at 10:00 PT / 13:00 ET. Laura (legal) is copied and will join for the redline walk. I reviewed the attached summary — thanks, Ava; it captures the five priority items we should discuss (liability cap, breach notice timeline, data deletion language, subprocessors, and audit rights).

Quick notes for the call agenda:
- 0–10m: Introductions and scope (Ava/Jordan + Novus procurement/security)
- 10–30m: Redline walk — Marissa/Laura to call out preferred language and alternatives
- 30–40m: Onboarding preflight (SSO/SCIM, SOC2 artifacts, network allowlists)
- 40–45m: Next steps & doc ownership (who produces final redline)

Ava/Jordan: please include a link to your SOC 2 pack in the invite. Laura, I'll bring suggested alt text for data deletion windows and a short fallback for the liability cap.
